rules.title: Jersey City: lessors and agents barred from using algorithmic rent-fixing Service Providers
rules.requirement: It is unlawful for any real estate lessor, agent, or subcontractor of either to subscribe to, contract with, exchange anything of value in return for, or otherwise use the services of a Service Provider. The term Service Provider is defined in a part of §218-12 that is not in this chunk.
rules.citation: Jersey City Ord. 25-076 amending Jersey City Code ch. 218, §218-12, subsection 2 (Unlawful Conduct), paragraph 1
rules.quoted_span: It is unlawful for any real estate lessor, agent, or subcontractor thereof, to subscribe to, contract with, or
rules.interaction: This ordinance amends §218-12 subsection 2 to clarify its language and follows Ord. 25-057, which is referenced but not reproduced. Sections 218-13 (Exempt dwellings), 218-14 (Occupancy required), 218-15 (Extension of time period), 218-16 (Violations and penalties) and 218-17 (Conflicts with state law) are listed as unchanged and their text is not in this chunk.

rules.title: Jersey City: Service Providers barred from facilitating agreements not to compete among lessors
rules.requirement: No Service Provider shall facilitate an agreement not to compete among real estate lessors with respect to any aspect of residential dwelling units, including rental pricing, fees, or any other rental terms.
rules.citation: Jersey City Ord. 25-076 amending Jersey City Code ch. 218, §218-12, subsection 2 (Unlawful Conduct), paragraph 2
rules.quoted_span: No service provider shall facilitate an agreement not to compete among real estate lessors with respect to
rules.interaction: This is a separate obligation from the lessor-side prohibition in paragraph 1. Its coverage and exemptions may be limited by unchanged sections not shown in this chunk.

Unchanged section 218-15 (Extension of time period) is not shown. An administrator must confirm the effective date. The retrieval date was not used.
